 The NSW Blues have revealed a 13-player squad for Saturday’s One-Day Cup match against Western Australia at the WACA in Perth, making seven changes.
 Having returned from Australia A duties in India, captain Lachlan Shaw rejoins the Blues’ white-ball team alongside Ben Dwarshuis, Sam Konstas, Josh Philippe and Tanveer Sangha.   
 Jack Nisbet has earned a recall, while Jack Edwards also returns to the One-Day Cup squad.   
 If selected, Bryce Jackson could make his white-ball debut for NSW this weekend, becoming the Blues’ 215 th one-day player.   
 Kurtis Patterson is being managed for the 50-over contest in Perth, while Naden Cooray, Ryan Hicks, Reiley Mark, Joe Colgan, Liam Hatcher and Charlie Stobo also drop out of the squad that faced Tasmania at Cricket Central last week.   
 The NSW Blues’ One-Day Cup match against Western Australia commences at the WACA on Saturday at 5pm AEDT (2pm local time). Australian fans can watch the action on cricket.com.au and Kayo Sports.  
 NSW Blues’ One-Day Cup Squad vs Western Australia, October 24   
 Lachlan Shaw (c), Sean Abbott, Oliver Davies, Ben Dwarshuis, Jack Edwards, Bryce Jackson, Riley Kingsell, Sam Konstas, Jack Nisbet, Josh Philippe, Will Salzmann, Tanveer Sangha, Jake Scott
